تستغرقن (form X)
# تَسْتَغْرِقْنَ (tastaḡriqna) /tas.taɣ.riq.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْرَقَ (istaḡraqa)
# تُسْتَغْرَقْنَ (tustaḡraqna) /tus.taɣ.raq.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْرَقَ (istaḡraqa)
